name: GPU Infrastructure for AI
description: The operator's view of data-center GPUs: what the current NVIDIA and AMD systems are, how they are packaged and connected, how the driver, CUDA/ROCm and container stack fit together, how to monitor and triage failing GPUs, how to share and size GPU memory, and what power, cooling and sourcing decisions follow.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: GPU Infrastructure for AI

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 16 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
